Snacks

Soft roasted vegetable fingers

Zöldséges sültek

8 months+ Sound idea 35 min 4 portions

Serve fingers that bend and mash. They are not crisps.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 2 medium Carrots (Cut into thick fingers)
  • 1 medium Parsnip (Peeled and cut into thick fingers)
  • 1 medium Zucchini (Cut into thick fingers)
  • 1 tablespoon Olive oil (Tossed through before roasting)

Allergens

none

Method

  1. Heat the oven to 190°C.
  2. Toss the vegetable fingers in the oil.
  3. Spread them in one layer.
  4. Roast until they bend easily, about 25 minutes.
  5. Take them out before the edges turn crisp, and cool slightly.

Sound idea

These are soft roasted fingers, not crisps. Hard browned edges are a choking texture.

Roast carrot, parsnip, and zucchini in olive oil until soft, with no salt. Take them out while they still bend.
